name: Public sector & social impact
summary: Replace 'profit' with the mission. Assess impact (outcomes per dollar), stakeholders and political feasibility, financial sustainability (funding and cost), and implementation capacity and risk.
opening_line: Since the objective isn't profit, I'd define success as impact on the mission, then assess the options on impact per dollar, stakeholder support, financial sustainability and ease of implementation.
when_not_to_use: For-profit clients, where the standard frameworks apply

buckets.name: Impact
questions: What outcome matters, and how do we measure it?

industry_adaptations.note: Outcomes: attainment, graduation rates; stakeholders: teachers, unions, parents.
Public energy planning: reliability, cost to citizens, emissions and energy security.

common_mistakes: Forcing a profit framework on a non-profit
